learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic general knowledge and basic specialized knowledge in the field of programming. The focus is still strongly on imperative programming, but initial object-oriented concepts are also taught. Students are able to apply the knowledge practically and solve simple to moderately difficult problems.
Students understand the concepts of modular software design.

Programming exercises take place during the lectures. Students are thus able to understand, criticize, and complement the content of their colleagues' programs with their own programs. They are able to create programs in a form that allows for team cooperation.
Students have the ability to create programs using a modern object-oriented programming platform.
Students can implement their own software engineering ideas and defend them against competing approaches.

syllabus_topics: Programming languages, machine language vs. high-level languages
Return value, name and parameter list
Instance variables, class variables, local variables
assessment_rules: The examination type is LN, written examination of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
